budget_items.what_was_recorded: The full minimum quarterly charge was billed to new owners; the Commission agreed to pro-rate the bill, reducing it.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bill submitted ARPA proposals for manholes, pump stations and a mobile generator; the Select Board will discuss all three on 11/1.
budget_items.quote: john reported bill submitted his proposal for $200k for manholes, $300k for pump stations and $90k for a mobile generator.
